[IDAT.4.4] For `logical` schemas, no-op reassertion preserves
the existing `ds_fact_t` (same pointer, same
`fact_id`). A meaningful-change reassertion is a
retract + assert; the old wrapper is freed and a
new one is allocated. Integrator callbacks see this
as an assert event followed by a retract event: the
arriving assert comes before the withdrawal it causes
([RFCS.6.7]). A consumer pairs the retract with the
fact it removes by `fact_id`, never by identity, since
the replacement shares the identity and is already live
when the retract arrives.
